chunks: There is no man from the people of a region who stands at 'Arafah among the believers except that Allah forgives the believing people of that region. And there is no man from the people of a household who stands at 'Arafah among the believers except that Allah forgives the believing people of that household.

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.بِعَرَفَةَ: at 'Arafah, the sacred place of standing during hajj
key_terms.وَقَفَ: stood in the ritual station of hajj

ai.seo_question: How does standing at 'Arafah benefit a believer's family and community?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the presence of a believing person at 'Arafah becomes a cause of divine forgiveness extending beyond the individual to other believers in his region and household. It highlights the immense virtue of hajj and the communal and familial blessings connected to sincere worship.
